title: A2A registration + /doctor chat output
what: Queen chat showed 'Failed to list agents' because A2A registration payload sometimes lacked a string endpoint and the server wasn't always ready at app launch.
/doctor and other Queen skills only updated the Queen status view, not the chat timeline.
fix: A2ARegistryClient.register now builds an explicit A2ARegisterPayload dictionary with a string endpoint, guaranteeing the registry receives http://127.0.0.1:9105/a2a.
QueenBackgroundService.registerA2A retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff, so a transient 'server not ready' state doesn't leave the client unregistered.
Background status polls call listAgents(silent: true), so periodic agent-list failures no longer spam the Queen chat.
QueenStatusViewModel.runSkillReturningOutput runs claude <skill> synchronously, captures stdout/stderr, and returns the text; ChatViewModel appends that text directly into the Queen chat.
verification: cargo run --bin clade-e2e passed; server health ok; app running.
UI automation via AXTextArea submitted /agents -> 'Online agents: trios-agent: TRIOS AGENT'.
UI automation submitted /doctor -> result text now appears in Queen chat (currently a model/auth message from the local claude CLI).
